scope.focus: Separate exterior proposal from photo-reconciled existing condition; retain v07 interior
scope.userReportedDiscussion: Owner reported smart accepts 3B alone but not 3A alone. This is not recorded documentary approval of the separate two-vehicle minimum, accessory wall exception, dimensions, finishes or complete site compliance.

Adoption is project design direction, not smart compliance acceptance. Private comment-row evidence is retained only in the internal companion report, not in this JSON or public projection.
scope.frozenOtherWork: Mercedes detail upgrades are out of this iteration. Existing shared counter/lounge and handover alternatives remain subject to geometry/operational review.
notDemonstratedByRender: MB site classification and display compliance
operational systems, staffing and VLAN separation

standards.separate_mb: Separate from MB in master p2; applicable dedicated positions only where stated

statusDefinitions.intended_review: Intended in v07; implementation and adequacy still require review, not a pass

statusDefinitions.retained_shared_review: Existing shared element intended to remain; function/capacity not certified
